Questions and answers

What is Senter?

In this glossary, Senter refers to: A battery-powered portable light source provided to crew members to assist in emergency evacuations, inspections, or operations in darkness.

How is Senter used in aviation?

In aviation communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Awak kabin, ambil senter dan periksa semua pintu keluar selama mati listrik."

Definition

A battery-powered portable light source provided to crew members to assist in emergency evacuations, inspections, or operations in darkness.
